description: This file contains unit tests for the MacNodeRuntime class, testing various command handling scenarios in a macOS environment. It includes tests for command rejection, environment overrides, camera and screen recording functionalities, and browser proxy communication.

classes.name: FakeMainActorServices
classes.description: A fake implementation of MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices used for testing screen recording, location, and authorization functionalities within MainActor context.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Simulates screen recording, returning a mock file path and audio capability.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the location authorization status, simulated as always authorized.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the location accuracy authorization, simulated as full accuracy.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Returns a fixed CLLocation object representing the current location.
